authority.approval: user, 2026-09-24: the E1-E7 / R1-R3 gate accepted; campaign readiness only

question: Do frontier restarts from the run's own archived states (arm F) improve the tick-0 policy over plain v1 (arm C) at 3,072,000 policy transitions?

arms.F: m7h_f_s{s}: v1 + reward v2 + Track 1 + btt_curriculum_frontier_v1
arms.C: historical runs/m7g_k/m7g_s{0,1,2}_v1 while R1-R3 pass on the frozen code; otherwise m7h_c_s{0,1,2}

sequencing: strictly sequential, one run at a time; the launch gate before each run; the extension only after a recorded n = 3 decision that requires it; the control-retrain branch only after a recorded user decision

curriculum.selection: after automatic resets only; u1 < 1/2 -> tick0, else a visit-weighted eligible cell w = 1/sqrt(1 + visits); an empty archive -> tick0_archive_empty
curriculum.initial_episode: every worker's first episode is an ordinary tick-0 start
curriculum.reset_contract: every exposed reset() returns the tick-0 observation and consumes nothing

launch_gate.boundaries: inclusive; a missing reading fails; commit and physical evaluated separately

in_run_memory_policy.physical: recorded and reported, never a stop trigger

stop_conditions: a hard failure or alert (prefix mismatch or precondition failure, more than 3 prefix-phase lifecycle failures, a leak, more than 10 game processes, a changed user config, low disk)
registered_settings.restart_policy: a stopped or partial run is moved to _partial (never deleted) and restarted from scratch after the launch gate passes again; a curriculum run is never resumed; no early stop on results
registered_settings.evaluation: post hoc, frozen statistics, tick-0 starts only (Phase K protocol), btt_eval_metrics_v1 with SSB64_RL_TARGET_DIAG=1, clear verification, census
registered_settings.training_inputs: the run's own finished training episodes only; never the crossing fixtures, the TAS, capture recordings, other runs or hand-written routes

R1.control_path: no curriculum component, record or file

historical_control.verification: python rl/m7h_campaign.py control-check (R1-R3 re-run on the frozen code; bound to its code fingerprint and executable)

evaluation_protocol.tick0_check: every evaluation artifact: no m7h_start label, initial observation tick 0, first row tick 0; every row: no m7h key
